sgw.interface.name.description: Network interface name for S1U (user plane) and default S11 control plane.

sgw.interface.address.description: IP address assigned to the S1U (and S11 if no separate S11 interface) interface.

sgw.interface.netmask.description: Network mask for the S1U/S11 interface.

sgw.s1c.name.description: Optional separate interface name for S1-C (control plane). If omitted, S1C shares S1U/S11 interface.

sgw.s1c.address.description: IP address for S1-C interface. Required only if s1c.name is specified.

sgw.s11.address.description: IP address for SGW S11 interface to MME. Defaults to sgw.interface.address if omitted.

sgw.gtpu.addr.description: SGW's own IP address used in GTP-U headers for S1-U packets.

sgw.fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name of this SGW for MME DNS lookup.

sgw.pgw_selection.description: Method to discover PGW: 'static' (explicit IP) or 'dns' (FQDN lookup).

sgw.pgw.addr.description: Static IP address of the PGW (used if pgw_selection='static').

sgw.pgw.fqdn.description: PGW FQDN for DNS resolution (used if pgw_selection='dns').

sgw.max_bearers_per_ue.description: Maximum number of active EPS bearers allowed per UE (1–11).

sgw.gtpu_timeouts.keepalive.description: GTP-U keepalive interval (seconds) between endpoint probes.

sgw.gtpu_timeouts.no_data_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) after which an inactive GTP-U tunnel is deleted.

sgw.log.file.description: Optional log file path. If omitted, logs go to stdout.

sgw.mme_list.description: List of MMEs known to this SGW (for load balancing and redundancy). Each entry should have at least 'ip'.

fqdn.description: Optional MME FQDN (used when IP is unavailable or for DNS fallback).

sgw.apns.description: List of APN configurations. Each entry defines APN name, SMF address, QoS, and optional AMBR.

smf.addr.description: IP address of the SMF (Session Management Function) / PGW-C endpoint handling this APN.

smf.fqdn.description: Optional SMF FQDN (if DNS resolution preferred).

qos.qci.description: QoS Class Identifier (1–9, 65–75). Common values: 1 (VoIP), 5 (IMS signaling), 9 (default data).

qos.arp.priority_level.description: Allocation and Retention Priority level (1–15); lower = higher priority.

qos.arp.pre_emption_vulnerability.description: Whether this bearer can be preempted by higher-priority bearers.

qos.arp.pre_emption_capability.description: Whether this bearer can preempt lower-priority bearers.

ambr.uplink.description: Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate (AMBR) uplink in kbps. 0 = unlimited.

sgw.nat.enabled.description: Enable NAT on SGW S1-U (rarely needed; typically handled by outer network).
